data: Microsoft delivered a strong fiscal 2024, with revenue rising 15.7% to $245.1 billion from $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023. Profitability expanded faster than the top line. Gross profit reached $171.0 billion in fiscal 2024 versus $146.1 billion in fiscal 2023, and operating income climbed to $109.4 billion from $88.5 billion. That produced a fiscal 2024 gross margin of 69.8% and an operating margin of 44.6%. Net income grew 21.8% to $88.1 billion in fiscal 2024 from $72.4 billion in fiscal 2023, lifting diluted EPS to $11.80 from $9.68. The company kept investing while it scaled, with R&D expense increasing to $29.5 billion in fiscal 2024 from $27.2 billion in fiscal 2023. We view the combination of double-digit growth and clear operating leverage as a supportive backdrop for the shares.
